text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S had relentlessly stacked up 
"results." Thanks to that, the crowd now 
watches with high expectations for her 
performance on the big stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other runners are a formidable lineup, 
including Tap Dance City and Zenno Rob 
Roy. Both make their declarations that 
victory will be theirs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S is glad for their fiery 
passion. She heads to the decisive battle 
to win the Arima Kinen and reign as an 
unyielding "Ordeal."
